answer: Concrete defense: stake-bonded uniqueness attestation. A new agent posts a refundable bond and proves sustained unique throughput before receiving paid work; probationary agents wait on a knoll of low-value tasks while peers verify their output. A flawless forged duplicate can broadcast a valid signal, yet every clone must independently lock its own bond. That turns a sybil swarm's cost from near zero into a linear outlay per fake identity, and bonds slashed for collusion are burned on an onyx ledger. Honest agents earn reputation, so attackers face rising spend against flat payoff.
